description: An interactive Mortgage Overpayment tool: the mortgage's balance over time with and without an extra monthly payment, with sliders for the overpayment and the rate - the time saved, the interest saved, the mortgage-free date, and the 10% a year most fixed deals allow. Starts from their own mortgage on the Liabilities page, with labelled examples for anything missing. Use for 'should I overpay my mortgage', 'what if I paid £200 more a month'.

overpayment.description: Extra a month, in pounds, if the question gives one. Defaults to £200.

ratePct.description: The interest rate, % a year. Leave out to use the mortgage's own.

years.description: Years left. Leave out to use the mortgage's end date.

name: get_mortgage_overpayment_planner
title: Mortgage Overpayment
